Renaissance Philanthropy | Research Engineer (Speech AI/ML) | Remote (worldwide)
Renaissance Philanthropy's aim is to activate a virtuous circle of increasing ambition and impact between philanthropists and innovators: by identifying frontier experts both in science and in new ways of solving problems; by tapping into the growing number of emerging philanthropists; and by building multi-sector initiatives that can harness the power of philanthropy, markets, and governments.
RenPhil's Engineering Hub supports mission-driven, grant-funded educational technology projects that seek to improve educational outcomes in fundamental skills like math and reading. This summer we're launching a program called LEVI Literacy, which has a goal of halving the number of struggling readers in the US within 5 years.
We're looking for an expert in modern voice AI to support this work. Our partner teams are building tools that assess and support early reading directly from children's speech in real classrooms — oral reading, spoken vocabulary tasks, whole-class instruction. These are hard, meaningful speech problems: young children's voices, noisy multi-speaker environments, and high stakes for getting it right — and fair — for every student.
We're looking for folks who:
- have built and operated production ASR or speech-processing systems
- know the full data-to-model pipeline: collection, annotation, fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment
- can speak the languages of both research and engineering
- want to help create a world where all children learn to read well.
If this sounds like you, please apply!
https://www.renaissancephilanthropy.org/careers

4be1392172dea861.description: Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. A Day in the Life The Data Platform & Services (DPS) value stream is responsible for overseeing enterprise data assets across the organization. This includes the management of data and analytics platforms, governance of data solutions, ensuring data quality and timeliness, maintaining data interfaces, enabling seamless integration with external systems, and supporting advanced analytics capabilities. Within this stream, the Enterprise Data Governance team plays a vital role by delivering metadata management services through the Enterprise Data Catalog (Atlan). These services empower business users to efficiently discover and access the data they need, and include capabilities such as metadata management, data lineage tracking, transformation logic transparency, and standardized business terminology. We are looking for a seasoned and highly skilled Principal Product Analyst (PA) with deep expertise in metadata integration and data governance solutions, specifically utilizing Atlan. In this role, you will be instrumental in analyzing business challenges and identifying opportunities, gathering and refining technical requirements, and designing future-state processes and automation solutions. The ideal candidate will bring strong proficiency across data platforms, automation technologies, cloud technologies (AWS S3), security and system integration. Your contributions will directly impact on our ability to deliver meaningful data insights, driving improved operational efficiency and supporting strategic decision-making across the organization. Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned. - Manage enterprise password vault and ensure consistent credential integrity across all systems. - Design, develop, and implement robust data integration solutions across systems and applications, using APIs, and integration tools such as Atlan. - Collaborate with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document requirements for data integration and metadata management initiatives, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical specifications. - Integrate metadata management tools with relational databases, ELT pipelines, and BI platforms to support enterprise-wide data transparency and governance. - Maintain, manage, and communicate the technical roadmap for new connector deployments and ensure alignment with key stakeholders - Ensure catalog and governance coverage aligns to enterprise data governance policies - Identify, inform, and suggest recent product functionality deployments and enablement for prioritization and implementation - Partner with data stewards to identify, define, and maintain critical business and technical metadata, and ensure comprehensive documentation. - Ensure comprehensive metadata availability in Atlan by reviewing data assets and verifying data lineage, with a focus on maintaining traceability, accuracy, and transparency of data movement across systems, including associated transformations and controls. - Leverage cloud technologies such as AWS S3 for scalable storage of metadata and architectural resources. - Develop and execute testing protocols to validate integration flows and data functionality, ensuring the quality and integrity of both data and metadata. - Monitor data integration pipelines, perform root cause analysis, and implement resolutions to technical and process-related issues. - Conduct ad hoc system and data analysis to optimize and troubleshoot integrations across environments. - Produce clear and comprehensive documentation of technical specifications, processes, and integration workflows for both technical and non-technical audiences. - Serve as a liaison between internal teams and external vendors to resolve support issues, manage help desk interactions, and promote operational efficiency. - Facilitate cross-functional collaboration with product managers, developers, data architects and other stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. - Champion continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for automation and staying current with emerging trends in cloud and metadata technologies. - Apply ITIL best practices to enhance service consistency, streamline processes, and elevate overall IT ecosystem performance. - Support data governance initiatives, regulatory compliance, and information security across the organization. Required Knowledge and Experience: - Overall 12+ years of IT experience with Bachelors degree in Engineering .
